consensus.question: What was the root cause of the 2 March outage?

answers.text: A bad database migration dropped an index, so queries timed out under load.
The index removed by the morning migration made reads slow; the DB fell over.
Root cause: a schema migration deleted a needed index and the database stalled.

consensus.agreed: A database schema migration removed a needed index, causing slow queries and the database to stall under load.
consensus.reason: All three answers independently identify the same root cause: a migration that deleted a required index, leading to degraded reads and database failure.

log.reason: All three answers independently identify the same root cause: a migration that deleted a required index, leading to degraded reads and database failure.
